name: Browser gateway
responsibility: Where a pane's command arrives, already admitted under its tab session's lease, and is carried out by the workhorse of the checkout the pane's tab shows
description: The gateway asks which checkout the pane's tab shows on every read and command, because the person can activate another one at any time: it hears the change and presents every pane of the tab again, with the workhorse of the new checkout. It dispatches each browser command to one action of that checkout's workhorse: a typed message or an interrupt (Stop) to the text actions (src/server/archboard/lib/codex-workbench-text-actions.ts), a queue edit to its queue, a new workhorse to its create action (codex-workbench-thread-links.ts), which makes the tab's coordinator ready first. A command that names a thread is admitted only when that thread is the link of the shown checkout, and a lease taken before a switch is refused as link_changed. A command runs on the workhorse its lease was claimed for: once it has run, only that workhorse's own link is asked whether it still stands, so a switch meanwhile does not make its outcome unknown. None of them passes through the workhorse operations.
